name: Comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP)
blurb: Common blood panel covering kidney and liver function, electrolytes and blood sugar.

name: Basic metabolic panel (BMP)
blurb: Smaller blood panel: electrolytes, kidney function, glucose and calcium.

name: Complete blood count (CBC) with differential
blurb: Counts red cells, white cells and platelets; screens for anemia and infection.

name: Lipid panel (cholesterol)
blurb: Total cholesterol, HDL, LDL and triglycerides.

name: TSH (thyroid stimulating hormone)
blurb: First-line screen for under- or over-active thyroid.

name: Hemoglobin A1c
blurb: Three-month average blood sugar; used to diagnose and monitor diabetes.

name: Vitamin D, 25-hydroxy
blurb: Measures vitamin D level.

name: PSA (prostate specific antigen)
blurb: Blood test used in prostate cancer screening.

name: Urinalysis with microscopy
blurb: Screens urine for infection, kidney problems and more.

name: Urine culture
blurb: Grows bacteria from urine to confirm a UTI and guide antibiotics.

name: Brain MRI without contrast
blurb: MRI scan of the brain without contrast dye.

name: Brain MRI with and without contrast
blurb: MRI scan of the brain before and after contrast dye.

name: Cervical spine (neck) MRI without contrast
blurb: MRI of the neck portion of the spine without contrast dye.

name: Lumbar spine (lower back) MRI without contrast
blurb: MRI of the lower back without contrast dye.

name: Knee MRI without contrast
blurb: MRI of the knee joint without contrast dye.

name: Shoulder MRI without contrast
blurb: MRI of the shoulder joint without contrast dye.

name: Head CT without contrast
blurb: CT scan of the head without contrast dye.

name: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
blurb: CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis with contrast dye.

name: CT abdomen and pelvis without contrast
blurb: CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis without contrast dye.

name: Chest X-ray
blurb: Standard chest X-ray.

name: Abdominal ultrasound (complete)
blurb: Ultrasound of the liver, gallbladder, pancreas, kidneys and spleen.

name: Thyroid ultrasound
blurb: Ultrasound of the thyroid gland.

name: Screening mammogram (both breasts)
blurb: Screening 3D mammogram of both breasts.

name: Bone density scan (DEXA)
blurb: Measures bone density, usually hip and spine.

name: ER visit, moderate severity (level 3)
blurb: Facility fee for a moderate-complexity emergency department visit.

name: ER visit, high severity (level 4)
blurb: Facility fee for a high-complexity emergency department visit.

name: ER visit, highest severity (level 5)
blurb: Facility fee for the highest-complexity emergency department visit.
